proof.text: A point s is in the image of j exactly when its residue-field morphism factors through j: use the proved Scheme.exists_comp_eq_of_mem_range for the forward implication, and evaluate a factorization at the closed point for the reverse. Applying hchar identifies this image with the residue-field universal rank-matching point locus.

For an affine open U of S, obtain the finite set R of ranks covering all rank-matching points in U. For every r in R, retrocompactness of the fixed-rank point locus makes its intersection with U compact.

Prove in Lean that the image under j of its inverse image of U equals the union over r in R of the fixed-rank point loci intersected with U. The forward inclusion uses the finite-rank coverage, and the reverse uses the image characterization. The finite union is compact. Since an immersion is a topological embedding, compactness of this image is equivalent to compactness of the inverse image. Apply Mathlib quasiCompact_iff_forall_isAffineOpen to conclude.
